canon_requests.new: A ghost collides with voxels only: it has no body collision and appears in no hit, push or perception query.
A closed door or closed trapdoor applies its block's full `light_filter`, concealment and sound attenuation.
Shapes with no micro-voxels (cross, ladder, fixture) keep their block's light filter, concealment and sound attenuation unscaled.
Panel, ladder, fence, pane, cross and fixture cells, resource nodes and cells marked by an explosion's rays break whole.

**Last stand.** In solo play only, a lethal hit that Death's Door does not prevent opens a 300-tick window, once per Folio; a successful timed input in that window leaves the Erratum at 1 HP, and on failure the hit kills. The world keeps running and further hits on the Erratum are negated during the window.

**Ledge mantle.** A JUMP press with forward input climbs a ledge whose top lies more than 550 mm and at most 2,000 mm above the floor the body last stood on; a jump adds no reach. **Sprint-slide.** A crouch press while sprinting forward on the ground at 5,000 mm/s or more starts a slide at the greater of the current speed and 8,000 mm/s, losing 8,000 mm/s² × the ground's friction, for at most 45 ticks, ending below 2,000 mm/s, when airborne or on a jump; 60-tick cooldown; no stamina cost.
canon_requests.why: DECISIONS 95, 99; Canon gaps G31; merged with doc 09 G26 and doc 12 G19

canon_requests.new: **Grappling tool.** A `cat.tool` item, never base kit: a 20,000 mm ray from the eye anchors on any block face at least 1,000 mm away and pulls the body at 12,000 mm/s without gravity for at most 120 ticks; it releases on a jump (velocity kept), on arrival within 1,000 mm, when blocked, gated or downed, or when the anchor block is gone (velocity × 0.25 on every release but a jump). A body is never an anchor.
canon_requests.why: DECISIONS 95, 99; Canon gaps G31; merged with doc 09 G26 and doc 12 G19

canon_requests.new: **Time of day and weather.** Each Folio rolls one time of day from its genre's table and one weather state (doc 12), fixed for the Folio. Time of day: dawn −1, day 0, dusk −1, night −3 sky levels. Weather terms apply only at cells with no micro-voxel above them (`sky_open`), except the sky-level term, which applies to every sky-lit source. Columns `sky_delta`, `sound_ddb` (added per sound step), `wet` (soaks bodies), `fire_bp` (multiplies fire spread), `fog`, `ambient_db`, `scent`, `snow`: clear 0, 0, 0, 10000, 0, 0, 0, 0; rain −1, 2, 1, 5000, 0, 5, 1, 0; storm −2, 4, 1, 2500, 1, 10, 1, 0; fog −1, 0, 0, 10000, 1, 0, 0, 0; snow −1, 2, 0, 5000, 1, 0, 1, 1; dust −1, 3, 0, 12500, 1, 5, 0, 0. Weather deposits no liquid or gas and changes no temperature.
